title: Chreatures rich body-local sensorimotor trajectory
description: Breaking NPZ contract for rich-body-v1. Partition keys and immutable sensor identities live in the manifest. Model arrays contain no resident identity, object label, world coordinate, heading, distance, or bearing.

observation.description: C-contiguous float32 [T+1,N,4453] in exact order rich-body-v1 rays4096, canonical pooled/nonretinal channels351, local physiology6

executed_actions.description: float32 [T,N,8], final clipped commands in thrust,yaw,gaze_pitch,grip,signal_low,signal_mid,signal_high,posture order

oral_command.description: float32 [T,N], executed eat command from the declared body-state law

transition_outcomes.description: float32 [T,N,8] actual t-to-t+1 outcomes in nutrition,contact,distance,effort,mechanical_work,ingested_mass,mouth_material_contacts,homeostatic_reward order; audit/training targets, never controller inputs

reset.description: bool [T+1,N], true only for the first observation of each fresh episode

neural_readouts.description: optional float32 [T+1,N,384] canonical full-MaleCNS readouts for the slow manager; not part of the 4453 worker observation
